description: The organization's Today summary (GET /today), counted exactly like the portal's Today: due_today, closed_today, awaiting_check, retake, photos_verified_7d and the needs list (each item's first reason of retake, issue, review, overdue, due_today). Archived, completed and demo projects never count (demo only with demo=true). The day is in zone (an IANA zone), else the org time zone, else UTC (timezone_fallback true). Read tier.

demo.description: Count demo / test projects too (default false)

zone.description: IANA time zone for the day boundary, e.g. America/Los_Angeles (default: the org time zone)

name: tascan_today
